headline: Prime SSE swell and a glassy morning — this is the day of the week.
today: Best setup around: chest-to-head-high SSE at a prime angle with dawn WNW then light SSW keeping it clean well into the morning. Surf it before the S onshore fills in the afternoon around the 2:50p high. Fun-shape or shortboard depending on the set — the good windows don't come often at Ditch, so go.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the run at 2.1-3.2ft with a cross-off dawn and morning — clean early before SW onshore takes over. Target the morning.
Decent size but evening SSW cranks to 20mph — blown out late. Morning WSW is the only calm patch.
Plenty of size to 3.4ft but wind builds to 20mph cross-on by evening. Gets ragged fast after midday.
